title: Paired regulatory result 1
description: Structural contract for one paired-regulatory-result-1 document returned by regsite.paired.predict_pair, including native invalid, unsupported, failed, no-candidate, unknown-roster and partial outcomes. Predicted differences are not measured regulatory effects. See ../docs/validation/paired-regulatory-runtime.md.
$comment: Resolve $ref values only through a local registry keyed by sibling schema file names; never retrieve them remotely. Each side prediction is validated by its complete native result schema (the RBS item schema selected by settings.profile, or the one-record Promoter 1.0 envelope); native results are never stripped. Validate strict JSON first: reject duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity. Schema acceptance cannot prove: any SHA256 value (request, prediction, side, identity, sequence, edit or candidate-scope hashes) or that pair_id, IDs, sequences and requests agree across the pair, edit map and native predictions; coordinate correspondence, including edit-map consistency, anchor/codon arithmetic, feature base paths, mapped runs, unmatched counts, genomic projection arithmetic and strand agreement; that rows visit candidates in roster order, pair at most once and use the correct reason; delta arithmetic (recoded - current), identity equality behind complete versus incomparable, or coverage counts and sums; integer-versus-float wire types, since JSON Schema treats integral floats as integers and integers as numbers; authoritative result bytes (67,108,864 maximum), resource budgets or deadline semantics, since deadline-dependent outcomes legitimately differ; or biological validity. Scores and log-score differences are model outputs, not probabilities, measured expression or proof of a gained or lost regulatory site.

edit_map.description: Complete paired-edit-map-1 produced by the edit factory.

limits.$comment: Provisional wrapper limits and the installed native limits emitted by this version; a limit change requires a schema update.

scalar.$comment: Null is unavailable, never zero; a present finite value, including zero, has a null reason.

mapping.description: Exact edit-factory interval map; every source base is retained in transcription order with an explicit null for an unmatched base.

feature.description: A native model interval as an ascending half-open local [start,end] pair, or null when the predictor returned no interval.

prediction.$comment: Exactly one native RBS result item, bound to its profile's result schema at the document root.

rbs_side.$comment: A request that passed wrapper preflight but failed native validation keeps its exact supplied spelling, so only its preflight-required fields are structural; natively validated requests must match the strict request schema.

prediction.$comment: The complete native one-record Promoter batch envelope.

promoter_side.$comment: A request that passed wrapper preflight but failed native validation keeps its exact supplied spelling, so only its preflight-required fields are structural; natively validated requests must match the strict request schema.

identity_mismatches.$comment: Differing identity names in model, settings, backend, calibration order.
